question: For customers who paid in CZK and made transactions at 'Value for money' gas stations, what is the consumption decrease rate from 2012 to 2013 for the customer who spent the most in total across all years?

WITH QualifyingCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND g."XCL_007" = 'Value for money'
),
CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID, SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN QualifyingCustomers AS qc ON ym."XCL_019" = qc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019"
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerTotals ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC LIMIT 1
),

    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID,
           SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN TopCustomer AS tc ON ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019", SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4)
)
SELECT CAST((SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') - (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2013') AS REAL) / (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') AS DecreaseRate

WITH QualifyingCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND g."XCL_007" = 'Value for money'
),
CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID, SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN QualifyingCustomers AS qc ON ym."XCL_019" = qc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019"
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerTotals ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC LIMIT 1
),
YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID,
           SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN TopCustomer AS tc ON ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019", SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4)
)
SELECT CAST((SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') - (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2013') AS REAL) / (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') AS DecreaseRate

WITH QualifyingCustomers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c."XCL_001" AS CustomerID
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c."XCL_001" = t."XCL_013"
    INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t."XCL_015" = g."XCL_004"
    WHERE c."XCL_003" = 'CZK'
      AND g."XCL_007" = 'Value for money'
),
CustomerTotals AS (
    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID, SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN QualifyingCustomers AS qc ON ym."XCL_019" = qc.CustomerID
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019"
),
TopCustomer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID FROM CustomerTotals ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC LIMIT 1
),
YearlyConsumption AS (
    SELECT ym."XCL_019" AS CustomerID,
           SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) AS Year,
           SUM(ym."XCL_021") AS Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    INNER JOIN TopCustomer AS tc ON ym."XCL_019" = tc.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY ym."XCL_019", SUBSTRING(ym."XCL_020", 1, 4)
)
SELECT CAST((SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') - (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2013') AS REAL) / (SELECT Consumption FROM YearlyConsumption WHERE Year = '2012') AS DecreaseRate

WITH czech_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.XCL_013 AS customer_id
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN gasstations g ON t.XCL_014 = g.XCL_004
    WHERE t.XCL_012 = 'CZK'
      AND g.XCL_007 = 'Value for money'
),
total_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.customer_id,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS total_spent
    FROM czech_customers cc
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON cc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM total_spending
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) AS year,
        SUM(t.XCL_018) AS consumption
    FROM top_customer tc
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON tc.customer_id = t.XCL_013
    WHERE strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY tc.customer_id, strftime('%Y', t.XCL_011)
)
SELECT 
    (cy2012.consumption - cy2013.consumption) / cy2012.consumption AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    (SELECT consumption FROM consumption_by_year WHERE year = '2012') cy2012,
    (SELECT consumption FROM consumption_by_year WHERE year = '2013') cy2013
